title: gompholobium simplicifolium
intro: Gompholobium simplicifolium, commonly known as the Western Australian pea, is a shrub native to Western Australia. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues such as asthma and bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Gompholobium simplicifolium include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
